headline: FPL G+A vs xGI after GW5: who's running hot and who's due, mean reversions have tended to happen in previous seasons!
body: Before I begin - These are FPL numbers, and FPL hands out assists the PL doesn't (won pens, rebounds, deflections). So read G+A here as FPL G+A. Made this because I wanted to see who's running hot after 5 gameweeks before doing my transfers. G+A is FPL goals + FPL assists, xGI is xG + xA as shown in FPL. All pulled from the FPL API after GW5. Anyone with at least one return or 1.0+ xGI is included, which is 157 players. Running hot: | Player | Club | FPL G+A | xGI | Diff | |---|---|---|---|---| | Groß | Brighton | 7 | 2.63 | +4.4 | | João Pedro | Chelsea | 6 | 2.36 | +3.6 | | Kostoulas | Brighton | 5 | 1.41 | +3.6 | | Semenyo | Man City | 5 | 1.49 | +3.5 | | Schade | Brentford | 5 | 1.84 | +3.2 | | Gvardiol | Man City | 4 | 0.96 | +3.0 | | Barnes | Newcastle | 4 | 1.10 | +2.9 | | Belloumi | Hull | 4 | 1.15 | +2.9 | Running cold: | Player | Club | FPL G+A | xGI | Diff | |---|---|---|---|---| | Igor Thiago | Brentford | 1 | 3.29 | -2.3 | | Rudoni | Coventry | 0 | 2.03 | -2.0 | | Gonzalo García | Fulham | 1 | 2.91 | -1.9 | | Bobb | Fulham | 0 | 1.68 | -1.7 | | Barry | Everton | 2 | 3.65 | -1.7 | | Iwobi | Fulham | 0 | 1.61 | -1.6 | | Le Fée | Sunderland | 2 | 3.40 | -1.4 | | Awoniyi | Coventry | 0 | 1.34 | -1.3 | A few things that jumped out: - João Pedro's goals are about right (3 from 2.17 xG). It's the 3 FPL assists from 0.19 xA doing the work. - García, Bobb and Iwobi have 1 G+A between them from 6.2 xGI. Rough start for Fulham's attack. - Haaland is 5 from 4.95, pretty much exactly where you'd expect. Obvious caveat: it's 5 games, so one deflection moves someone a lot. And since FPL assists are more generous than xA, most players end up above the line, so it's more useful to compare players with each other than with zero. Happy to share the CSV if anyone wants it.   submitted by   /u/Low-Market7848 [link]   [comments]
